proposed_reference_answer_from_pending_d: Two official LSPU sources disagree. The Citizen's Charter 2026 1st Edition Dropping of Subjects card (Colleges, page 98) lists Fees: P30.00. The Student Handbook Dropping Grades Policy (page 39) states a dropping fee of P20/unit (LSPU BOR 1046, s.2012). A human reviewer must choose the in-force figure; this draft does not pick a winner.
recommended_revised_reference_answer_NOT: Two official LSPU sources state different per-unit dropping fees and do not, by themselves, establish a single in-force amount. The Citizen's Charter 2026, 1st Edition, Dropping of Subjects (Colleges; Who may avail: New and Transferee Students) lists P30.00/unit. The Student Handbook 2021, Sec. 4.3, states P20/unit is required (LSPU BOR 1046, s.2012). A later authoritative fee schedule is required before this can be a single-number gold answer.
